topic: Fan-made EA FC game simulation: Portugal with Ronaldo vs Spain with Yamal/Pedri in a hypothetical World Cup final, with AI-voiced banter overlays
hero: Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal, in-game and face-cam avatar)
hero_role: protagonist/fantasy GOAT; opposite avatars of Messi and Yamal as rivals
hook: EA FC pitch wide view with Ronaldo headphone face-cam square top-right and caption 'VIP' banner; voice-over 'Can the goat win the World Cup final'
subtitle_style: none; in-game scoreboard bug (POR 0-0 ESP) bottom-centre
reaction_overlays: square face-cam avatars of Ronaldo (red headphones), Messi (blue headphones) and Yamal (red headphones, Barca card) in top-right corner, switching by who speaks/scores
transition_summary: Continuous gameplay with few hard cuts; face-cam swaps and in-game replay cuts at goals; about 1 cut per 10 s
audio_note: AI-voiced banter between avatars over game audio, with music (transcript: 'Can the goat win the World Cup final versus Yamal and Pedri')
